quote: We employ three expert annotators to manually label each question with knowledge concepts. Cross-validation is performed to ensure at least two experts have identical annotations for the same question.
guideline: The annotators label questions with knowledge concepts and verify consistency across four aspects: (1) The consistency between the questions and diagrams; (2) The correctness of the answers to the questions; (3) The alignments between problems and the knowledge concepts; (4) Each problem contains a unique solution path.
